software.name: GFOpenUpdate
software.notes: GFOpenUpdate 0.3: the GFOS updater, now reading gfosdistribution's software/index.txt (backlog AC-280). Double-click it: its window lists what gfosdistribution has against what is installed (newer, not installed, up to date); Install all or Install for one; each download is checked against the catalogue's size and SHA-256 before GFOpenUpTool INSTALL puts it in; offers a restart after an update. Shell: GFOpenUpdate LIST, GET=<Name>. Needs a 68040, AmigaOS 3.2+ or GFOS, GFOpenUp 0.8.30+ (httpget, GFOpenTLS, GFOpenCompress, GFOpenUpTool), network. Changed since 0.2: reads gfosdistribution (0.2 only GFOpenUp's own release, kept as fallback); installs software not yet installed; Install all; opens its window from its icon (an older one from WBStartup steps aside); restart offer. Lab t7-warmux-20261124 (Instance-32 copy): real catalogue listed, GFOpenSQLite fetched and SHA-256 matched. Built in the kitchen, job j20261124T225432-f3498a (os32-gcc16-open9), gfopenup e6f8e6a.
